notes.title: New Tame It Too! Demo
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/168abc9c162aadf5f24daea1e5aaa549aeb42a45.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Great news — [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2962010/Tame_It_Too/"]the brand-new demo for Tame It Too![/url] is out now! We've been planning to update the Steam demo for a long time, and now it's finally ready! The new demo includes the storyline up to Chapter 1, a revamped breeding system with all the latest features and girls, and a huge number of changes and improvements![/p][p]We've packed this demo update with TONS of new content, so let's dive in![/p][p][b]PROLOGUE[/b][/p][p][b]The Temple & The Puzzle[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/dacb26701f72e8f25b22d9effc318a3c38ff09b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The temple ruins have undergone significant changes as their narrative purpose has evolved. The dragon statue has been replaced with a mysterious teleporter, and there is a fun new puzzle near it. All frescoes on the columns have been updated too, examine them to learn more about the local lore![/p][p][b]Changes to Cat and Octa Quests[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/c6a14ee823c5ba7a2935196e0d6f9506fddd4890.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We thought you'd prefer getting to the "sweet part" sooner in the prologue, so now after finding Cat and Octa you can immediately get "hot and heavy" with them, and only afterwards cook them treats and receive rewards.[/p][p][b]New Fairy Quest[/b][/p][p]A completely new Fairy quest has been added to the prologue! You'll need to discover what mischief she's been up to and why she needs close watching!
This quest connects Tame It Too! with the Tame It! Christmas add-on and reveals more about Fairy's abilities that will play a role in the future story.[/p][p][b]New Hot Scene[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/229fedd5ead0bf3cd188f1db11337928c2e9e467.jpg"][/img][/p][p]During Fairy’s quest you'll see a new group hot scene we've worked hard on. This is our first experiment with real-time 3D interactive scenes involving multiple characters!
[/p][p][b]TELEPORTS

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/684b8a8ae702d25adb193807d9de185a79011f6f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]One of the most important new features in this update! We've long promised players to simplify island navigation, and now it's become much easier and faster.

While there were already some teleports on the island, we've added more to cover the entire territory at roughly equal distances, ensuring convenient travel between points.

The teleports system unlocks after solving the temple puzzle. Then you just need to find crystals to activate them all! You'll get 4 crystals in the temple plus one from Octa.
[/p][p][b]SPIDERS

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/3a52d3488658441ce27332450ff82569a5786bf3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The game now has its first enemies that don't just sit in one place like our lazy, fat crocodiles, these can give you a real scare by suddenly jumping out from bushes!
Don't worry though, the spiders aren't too scary and just add some fun, making you a bit more cautious at night. Watch for those glowing red eyes![/p][p][b]BREEDING

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/aefd0f7318167c2c6004d1cc05a40e8e696afceb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The updated breeding system opens vast new possibilities for experimentation! Now you can breed amazingly vibrant, unique beauties who inherit not just physical traits from their mothers and nurses, but also useful skills and attributes!

[i][b]Important![/b][/i] Breeding still isn't integrated into the game and launches separately via a button in the main menu.
[/p][p][b]New Girls[/b][/p][p]Mana and Cat are now available in the breeding mode! Cat can't get pregnant, but can be a nurse and pass on her genes to the next generation. Trust us, girls with her genes turn out exceptionally unique and hot![/p][p][b]Feeding System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/4d22784155fd216e6f23de106c3dff8d39fa58d5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can now (and should!) feed your girls! A table has been added to the construction menu where you can place food for your girls. Cook different dishes to please them! Different foods improve their attitude toward you, allowing you to assign various tasks.[/p][p][b]Task System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/800ac7499e4f6a0c4947eaf0c00aef8d60dc7730.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Build a task board that lets you assign various tasks to girls and track their current status and activities![/p][p][b]New Breeding Model[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/41140860091d59262b20b40a0f92e94fd34e1b51.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We've created a universal girl model that will serve as the foundation for all new generations, ensuring stable and smooth transfer of genes from mothers and nurses.[/p][p][b]More Realistic Genetics[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/64341633d9f7afaec52d1c51fd8148fc0effb97d.jpg"][/img]The gene inheritance system was a challenging, but extremely interesting task we worked hard on. The next generation clearly reflects the influence of mothers' genes. You'll be able to track inherited traits and breed girls that perfectly match your tastes!
[/p][p][b]GENERAL CHANGES AND ADDITIONS[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/bf7a530eab0f8e3d20de11599451a49083d4056a.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Two new main girls: Bunny and Mana;[/p][/*][*][p]Several new hot scenes, very steamy! We're creating scenes in different styles and constantly experimenting with presentation, poses, and kinks to appeal to diverse player tastes;[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced audio for hot scenes: now featuring not just music but also lewd sounds. While not full voice acting yet, this is a big step in that direction. The accompanying sounds make scenes hotter and more lively;[/p][/*][*][p]Sprint! Moving around the island is now much faster;[/p][/*][*][p]New localizations: Russian, Spanish, Chinese (Spanish and Chinese currently use AI translation but will be properly edited before full release);[/p][/*][*][p]Lee's model improvements: better looks and smoother, more realistic running animations;[/p][/*][*][p]Added weapon/tool durability system: new survival depth, adding a fun extra challenge;[/p][/*][*][p]Basic difficulty settings (to be expanded with more options by full release).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Full game dev is charging ahead! Next up: Finalizing core mechanics, then packing in story content, minigames, steamy scenes, new areas, and characters. We’re aiming to wrap development next year and we can’t wait![/p][p]Support us by wishlisting Tame It Too! It’s a huge help for Steam visibility, and we’ll love you forever for it.[/p][p]Stay tuned, the best is yet to come! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/9548dba5dd04d8207d61f26f817e58659efa5c1d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Tame It Too! DLC Breeding Prototype Release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We've updated the DLC prototype of Tame It Too! with the long-awaited breeding mechanics. We're glad to finally show you what we've got!

It's very easy to start breeding in this prototype.
Since the breeding features are not yet story related, all you need to do is clean up the camp, build a tent and a workbench, then a purple icon will appear at the edge of the camp that will allow you to start the breeding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/9e0ffde98ef0c8648792e03c9d279cd4ee687133.jpg[/img]
Please note that due to a change in the save system to support multiple saves and future game growth, old saves are not compatible with this prototype!

[h2]What awaits you in this update[/h2]

First of all, there are two new monster girls, Bunny and Lily. You'll meet and tame them as story characters in the full game, but for now, they're both ready to do a variety of naughty things with you, so you can start right away with the hottest part! 

[h3]Breeding System[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/557b27676ace19638a78fe4302e1dbd6823e2437.jpg[/img]
You can start to breed new monster beauties as soon as you launch the breeding prototype. The process of breeding new generations of girls will definitely surprise you!

At first everything is clear and quite simple, because it all starts with sex, of course! After successful impregnation, you'll be able to watch the girl's belly grow and other body changes, such as breast enlargement. You can also have sex with your pregnant beauties!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/f272a128ea63487285a645d2d4e0e9314748aead.jpg[/img]
Things become more interesting from here on out! There's nothing complicated about breeding, but the process is quite unique, so it may raise some questions.

[b]Briefly, your steps to breed a new girl are as follows:[/b]

[list]
[*] Have sex. Once is enough, but you can try out all the available poses as many times as you like, just remember to keep your energy up!
[*] Click on the girl when she is lying on the bed with the red exclamation mark above her;
[*] Pick up what she gave birth to and bring it to the nest;
[*] Assign one of the girls to nurse by taking her to the nest;
[*] Wait for a new girl to appear and build a bed for her.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/421c54bf19acd101ca246417501d92dc88d5d482.jpg[/img]
All new girls appear as adults, and you can continue breeding with them right away to get even more colorful wild beauties!

[h3]Variety[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/4a86b9fb4e8f4a1214dd32a31ee311b0c8d42530.jpg[/img]
You'll be able to breed girls of many different colors and body shapes, so there's plenty of freedom for imagination and experimentation!
It will not yet be possible to breed girls of different heights, faces and several other small traits in the breeding prototype, but all this is planned for future patrons' releases! 

[h3]Construction[/h3]
There are several new items available for you to build in this prototype, the most important of which is a bed. Each girl will need her own bed for sleeping and giving birth, and a new girl cannot be born if there is no room for her in your camp. In the full game, Lee won't have to sleep in a tent while girls sleep on beds, it will be different and you'll have the opportunity to build a house for Lee.

Hurry up and try it out for yourself! Feel free to share what kind of girls you breed in our [url=https://discord.gg/EGZXXaY]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Manka_Games]Twitter[/url]! 
We'll be very grateful for your comments, so don't hesitate to tell us what you think!

This is the last of our prototypes for this game, the full-fledged Tame It Too! is ahead and we're already actively working on it! We plan to do regular releases for our patrons on Patreon, while the game is in development, and then make a big release on Steam, when the game will be finished. 
So stay tuned not to miss anything!

notes.title: Tame It Too! Second Prototype Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/e6f69045ede8c4f1af01f89853ee7d762ec93d1c.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

We are happy to present you the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219340/Tame_It_Sequel_Prototype/]second prototype of Tame It Too[/url]!

We completely redesigned the game from the first prototype, rebuilding everything on a new engine, with new graphics and new features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/c461d6d7184610ec6738d027e2800c1647da05da.jpg[/img]
There's a pretty big island waiting for you to explore freely. In addition to the familiar local sights, we have added several new points of interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/56a4437b31a4fec0cbd95cea8bf1e17f3008264a.jpg[/img]
The island is full of life, there are different animals living in all corners of the island, you can hunt them or just have fun running after them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/575e7e065c648fe0a6f6b8e1676c189df57971e5.png[/img]
You'll also have the opportunity to gather resources, build your camp, cook food, everything that implies survival game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/fe6b9fb3a820e4405366180d1b13629c419afcd4.jpg[/img]
And of course you can communicate with your girls, Cat and Octa, treat them with yummy food, and watch hot scenes with each of them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/bb64b7b4fe809c392d5191d73cd39f7b433599b9.jpg[/img]
You'll be accompanied throughout the island by Fairy, who Lee has brought back from the Island of Fairies and has no intention of letting go yet. Fairy has her own opinion about everything that's going on, and she won't stop nagging and swearing at Lee the whole way. So she'll be a fun companion to set the mood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/6a3920a33f6f970a26e02df264c120918d4bcfba.jpg[/img]
We should also note that since this is the prototype of the possible game, it doesn't have all the features yet and can't be considered a full-fledged continuation of the story. With this prototype, we want to show you what the future game could look like with your support.

Thank you all for your interest in our games and for your kind words of support. Thanks to you, we continue to make progress!

notes.title: Tame It Too! Development News
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/0dbb0fcb140e21800948d32ac2ebb8a9ef13c023.png[/img]
Hi, everyone!

We have some great news for all Tame It! fans waiting for the sequel to the game. As you may remember, we released the first prototype of Tame It Too! last year. The feedback we received on the first prototype was restrained. We spent some time trying to optimize the game on UE, but we still didn't get a decent result. This fall we made a difficult but hopefully correct decision to start Tame It Too! from scratch on a less voracious engine. The main requirements are to keep the general concept of the first prototype, to add survival gameplay, to provide more accessibility on the hardware side by simplifying the graphics. And to simplify the starting location a bit, so that it would be easier for you to find the Cat.

And now the work on the new Tame It Too! prototype is progressing at a very good pace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/45c13ea32f5e544f5577d44b745ce88efab2939b.png[/img]
The landscape will be familiar to you from the previous prototype, but there will be some changes. Among other things, our goal is to make moving around the island easier and faster, and we are taking into account your suggestions that you wrote to us about after the first prototype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/e7675589ba662a3588479cd0b6d045c59ccefc17.png[/img]
The prototype already has almost all of the basic survival mechanics in place. Lee can gather materials for construction, can build his shelter, can set up and light a fireplace, can hunt and gather useful resources. Now we're actively working on crafting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/7656ea656f0cac0d2d7dd3affa8ac2761332766c.png[/img]
We already filled locations with life. There are crabs running on the beach, hares jumping in the woods, fish swimming in the water, and birds flying in the sky. You’ll be able to hunt animals and crabs and cook their meat! And in the future we plan to add more complex cooking too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/591bd861a7d2d1812d6f1f75b29fe71085e32865.png[/img]
More and more locations are getting a finished look. Recently we paid special attention to the swamp area. Now it's an atmospheric and dangerous place where you have to be careful not to fall into the jaws of crocodiles lurking in the water!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/72e5cef481a8e710c3cd71c3e7fc257635cff831.png[/img]
We continue to fill the locations with new details to make it fun for you to explore the island. We have added several new points of interest to the island map and placed quest items where they should be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/e2fe4536b8053e0afc9056dee8cdd2f2a7ad0061.png[/img]
We have put almost all of the texts into the game, which, as you may remember, for such a small prototype, is quite a lot. Plus, as new points of interest were added, new phrases for reacting to them were added as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/33a8b0f6e36176e71f9b9d7b01c6ece473c66911.png[/img]
We're almost done with all the major UIs. We are now in the process of integrating and refining the crafting interface into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/8237f0623e2b934aa1c20befed45147f25df92df.png[/img]
Now we are working the animated scenes with Cat, Octa and Fairy into the game, which will require some tweaks due to the fact that we have moved to a different engine.

We also want to let you know that the creation of a new character is gradually moving forward. It's a bunny girl, and some of you may have seen her in the early 2D visual concepts we showed last year on our Patreon. We're not sure if we'll be able to finish her in time for the first release of this prototype, but in any case, work on her 3D model continues well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/624c69ef8bcd875663d99eafb3d7fdde43d36dc1.png[/img]
Overall, the new prototype can be expected very soon, no specific dates yet, but we'll be sure to announce it when we get closer to release.

In addition to the Tame It Too! prototype, we are also actively working on another new game - (non)trivial! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/295c37f48639046dc2ea06a4dd66d1bd5d9f8a1b.png[/img]
[b](non)trivial[/b] — is a stealth adventure game with a detective element in an urban fantasy setting. You’ll have to uncover the deepest secrets of the people around you, your neighbors, enemies and interesting passers-by. You’ll have the opportunity to solve a crime that the whole city is buzzing about and reveal a mystery that is more than a thousand years old!

We have already released a demo recently! You can find out more about the game on our [url=https://manka.games/games/-non-trivial]website[/url] and Patreon.


Thank you for your interest in our games!
We wish you all a great mood and stay tuned so you don't miss anything!

notes.title: Tame It! Christmas Story Release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We came to you with a Christmas present today! Here is the new Tame It! addon — Christmas Story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/a04a08d6c94a924021381d2767d8b83bdb7b9c83.png[/img]
You will be immersed in the atmosphere of exciting holiday preparations, decorate a big beautiful Christmas tree in a cozy living room with a fireplace and meet your beautiful girlfriend with presents... but it's not that simple! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/c6b9e3294626d63281ba19419057df3cb9c1d1a1.png[/img]
There is a mystery, cool plot twists and even a little bit of mystique waiting for you! You won't be able to predict what will happen next! This is one of Lee's most unusual adventures, so get ready to be amazed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/697728aa677e88126727be02f53d3677df3af725.png[/img]
In addition to the unusual setting, we've added new quest mechanics and a new inventory interaction. You'll be able to take an item from inventory in your hand and use it on an active area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/377fe760e51994f26b4e527e313dcc7fa8c1b48c.png[/img]
For dessert, we've prepared three amazingly hot animated scenes with a wide variety of possible actions! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/2cf85f44560d81076356e521592c67d757e4288d.png[/img]
And of course we’re taking part in the Steam Winter Sale, which starts December 21st! [b]Tame It! is 50% off[/b] this time! 

Thank you for your support, dear friends! Your love for Tame It! and its characters inspired us to create this addon. We really appreciate you being with us as you help us move forward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/c9125d42b081992d022f42850b1f63d012b9b254.png[/img]
We won't keep you any longer, because Tonya is already waiting for you!

notes.title: Tame It! Christmas Addon Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/1430a4297841cd87795f9fa84a403194554d9a66.png[/img]
Hi everyone!

We have been working on a Christmas present for all of you for some time now, and today we want to officially announce it and to tell you more about it.

So, friends, this Christmas you are going to get a new addon to Tame It! And it will be quite different from everything we have released in the world of Tame It! before!

You will spend Christmas with Tonya in a nice, cozy apartment! Where there will be a fireplace, a Christmas tree and presents! Yes, that's how things are!

But how did it happen? Why isn't Lee on tropical islands and struggling to survive? All the answers are waiting for you in the addon!

We took a step away from the usual gameplay. Quest elements in this addon are intertwined with a light puzzle component and even with some mystics! We are sure that the plot will surprise you!

And you are probably wondering if there will be something hot in this addon. The answer is: it will be very hot!

Get ready to dive into the holiday atmosphere in the Tame It! Christmas Story!

The addon will be released on Steam during the Christmas sale and will be available for free to all owners of the Tame It! game!

Stay tuned not to miss anything interesting!

notes.title: Tame It! Side Stories
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/e7ed714f67e593a899037cb390e2975604e3f476.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

For quite some time we wanted to do something in the world of Tame It! to surprise and delight you, and besides, we still have some unrealized ideas that we would like to fulfill. At first, we were thinking of making a small add-on like the Fairy Island one, but we figured it would take too much time because of the large amount of work we were doing on our new game project. And then we had an amazing idea — we'd make a comic! 
[b]Yes, you got it right, we made a comic on Tame It![/b]

Before reaching the big island, Lee and the girls traveled to several small islands and had various adventures that didn't appear in the main story of the game, but remained as drafts in the game scenario. We decided to gradually bring them to life in the form of comics, and today you can see the first issue of Tame It! Side Stories!

A new adventure, a new mystery, and a new kink — that's what awaits you in this chapter of the comic!

[b]After the game update, the comic will be available in the game folder by address:  [/b]Comics/TameIt_Comic_1.pdf

It should be noted that since the comic book is a side story to the main plot, much of it may not be clear or as interesting without playing the game. Therefore, before you read it, please go through the game to get to know the characters and find out their story.

We're thinking about the possibility of releasing this story in the game format in the future as well, since we've got a lot of visual material for that while making the comic. We won't foresee yet when we'll be able to make it happen, but we'll strive to do so!

Thank you for your interest in our games and for all your support!

notes.title: Tame It! DLC Release
notes.notes:
We finally made it! We are happy to bring you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219340/Tame_It_Sequel_Prototype/]the prototype of Tame It Too![/url] — our first step to a really big game! 

After the release of the first addon, we were at a crossroads. On the one hand we planned to make another addon before the end of the year, we had nice ideas for it, another little adventure on a new island with a new monster-girl. But on the other hand we couldn't stop thinking about a sequel, and we realized we had an opportunity to show you what a sequel could look like at least in prototype form. That's why in the end we decided it would be more interesting both for us and for you, dear players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/f49209fbaf8bde01a41b3d25b2a6d330e796ba09.jpg[/img]

We have been working on the prototype of Tame It Too! for over six months, and now we can finally show you what we made!
The previous engine we used for Tame It! was specifically created for visual novels and it really limited us in what we wanted to make. That's why we switched to Unreal Engine 5 for our prototype development and future game, which could bring all our ideas to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/e2a9a58cc7d87a07866834f1dc76abd61fb6e4cd.jpg[/img]

Here in the prototype you'll see just a small piece of the future world of Tame It Too! Although the available area is the equal in size to the island from the first game, and probably exceeds it, the real size of the territory, where the events of the future game will unfold, plan to be at least five times larger. But even in the territory that is available to you now, there are a lot of interesting things. We tried to include different biomes and different fauna, including the crabs you know so well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/6da268b8b875ab934684eb6693b84974372268c4.jpg[/img]

As for the character models, we use the models from the first game for now. And even Octa, who, as many of you expected, should be pregnant by now, doesn't show it yet. In the future we plan to completely rework the previous characters’ models, as well as rework and refine some of the environment models.

As a reminder, the prototype doesn't have the survival functionality you're used to and a proper plot yet. We focused on laying the base for the future game, to show you what it will look like, to let you experience more freedom in the world of Tame It! and the possibilities the new engine gave us. There may be some flaws and bugs in the game and some things, such as the bonus scene, we plan to redo in the future. 
However, Tame It Too! is a direct continuation of the first part and we meet the characters in about the same place where we parted with them. Therefore, we can consider this prototype as a story prologue to the main game. 

If you like Tame It! and you liked Tame It Too! prototype we would love to have you as part of our community and hope to create a complete game with lots of cool features together! 

Many thanks to everyone who keeps supporting us! We are very grateful to you! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219340/Tame_It_Sequel_Prototype/?curator_clanid=41010224

notes.title: Tame It! DLC announce
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

We're glad to announce that we’ll release the sequel prototype to Tame It! by the end of this year!

We planned to make another addon this year and show you a new small island with its unusual inhabitants. But eventually we decided not to extend the story, which has already ended, but to make a quality leap forward and continue the adventures of Lee in a new format. 

It would be the first step to a full-fledged sequel — [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219340/Tame_It_Sequel_Prototype/]Tame It Too![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/af014b40628f86e2e58f820b805e7431d567af1e.png[/img]

We switched to a new engine and it's Unreal Engine 5! It instantly gave us a huge room for possibilities. You are now free to explore everything around with a third-person view!

We have a lot of plans and ideas for the future game, we want to fit all the good old features and a lot of new ones into it. 

We would like to draw your attention to the fact that for now we’re only releasing the prototype of the sequel. It won't have the same survival gameplay features you're used to in Tame It! yet, so there's no building, hunting, fishing and other mini-games, and only a bit of storyline. But the foundation of the game where all of this may appear is already in this prototype. And if you liked the story, characters and mechanics of Tame It!, and if you want to get it all on a new level, completely redesigned and improved, then with your support this prototype can become a full-fledged game! 

[h3]What awaits you in the prototype[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/2c6cfdc4bf56e84e526182521edc6fc20777b32e.png[/img]

You'll find yourself on a large new island that you can explore as much as you want. A small but interesting quest awaits you, which will help to uncover one of the mysteries of the island and give food for thought about the origin of the local creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/ebf9db70c576198776286cb8b0588897d33f3813.png[/img]

Cat and Octa will also go exploring the island, each in their own direction, and Lee will have to find them in the jungle. And of course, we couldn't leave you without something hot, so we've prepared a delicious bonus scene with one of the girls for you! 

[h3]Steam release[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/d716b73f085dd847d5eec69fc032bf92330975b3.png[/img]

Right now the prototype is in its final stages of development and we expect to release it in December! And we can already tell you that the prototype will be free for all Tame It! owners on Steam! 

Our prototype already has a Steam page, where we tell more about the prototype features and the plans for the sequel! Add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219340/Tame_It_Sequel_Prototype/]the DLC page[/url] to your Wishlist so you don't miss it! 

And good news for those who haven't got Tame It! yet — during the Christmas Sale, we will have a 50% discount! So don't forget to check it out!

notes.title: Tame It! Steam Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/481b8ee0b80e1a640ba6bddb8d1ce60e099748ed.jpg[/img]

It finally happened! After almost two years of hard work Tame It! released on Steam! We’re excited to reveal the final version of our first game to you at last. It’s a unique survival adventure game, where you face a lot of interesting tasks on a small island, including communication with very unusual inhabitants of this place. Overcome the language barrier and tame wild beauties, find the traces of your missing companion and solve the mystery of the island, and of course survive — all this awaits you in Tame It!   

The game is accessible to players from all over the world, because all the dialogues and interfaces are provided using emoji! In addition, there is a full text version in English and German, as well as the option to select the difficulty level. Who knows, maybe you're an experienced Robinsons and prefer hardcore gaming?

Play it, add it to your wishlist and try the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1706850/Tame_It/

And we've got a great soundtrack too! Take the atmosphere of a tropical island adventure with you wherever you go!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711860/Tame_It_Soundtrack/

It wouldn't have been possible without the support of our dear patrons and the community, and we are really grateful to all of you! This weekend we’ll talk about our ideas and your suggestions for the sequel. And we hope to announce our next game soon enough! So stay tuned!
